arabic text: LEKAR SARE HUSSAIN KO DAMAN MAI KEHTI THI, KYA BHOOL GAYE APNI SAKINA KO EY BABA
english translation text: HOLDING THE BEAUTIFUL FACE OF HER FATHER HUSSAIN IN HER LAP SHE ASKED,\nHAVE YOU FORGOTTEN YOUR SAKINA OH FATHER

arabic text: CHEHRA MERA ZAKHMI HUWA PAR TU NAHI AYA, KYA BHOOL GAYE APNI SAKINA KO EY BABA
english translation text: MY FACE WAS WOUNDED, BUT YOU NEVER CAME,\nHAVE YOU FORGOTTEN YOUR SAKINA OH FATHER.

arabic text:
JO CHOT MUJHE LAGTI TOU BECHAIN TU REHTA
MAI DARD SE ROTI TOU YE BARDHASH NA HOTA
AB KISTARHA SEEH PATEHO BABA MERA RONA
KYA BHOOL GAYE APNI SAKINA KO EY BABA
english translation text:
WITH EVERY WOUND I GET, YOU’D BE SO RESTLESS,
IF I SHED TEARS, YOU WOULDN’T TOLERATE THAT,
HOW CAN YOU RESIST MY TEARS OH FATHER
HAVE YOU FORGOTTEN YOUR SAKINA OH FATHER

arabic text:
JHALTI HUWI RETI PE CHALAYA GAYA MUJHKO
CHALTE HUWE NAQE SE GHIRAYA GAYA MUJHKO
DAADI KI TARHA MERA BHI PEHLU HAI SHIKASTA
KYA BHOOL GAYE APNI SAKINA KO EY BABA
english translation text:
I WAS MADE TO WALK ON BURNING SAND,
DURING THE DREADFUL WALK, I WAS THROWN DOWN,
JUST LIKE MY GRANDMOTHER, I TOO HAVE BROKEN RIBS,
HAVE YOU FORGOTTEN YOUR SAKINA OH FATHER

arabic text:
PHUPHIYU SE MUHABBAT THI INHE ISLIYE BABA
HAA SHAME GHAREEBA MAI THE AYE MERE DADA
TU MERI MADAD KELIYE EKH BAAR NA AYA
KYA BHOOL GAYE APNI SAKINA KO EY BABA
english translation text:
HE LOVED MY AUNTIES FATHER,
WHICH IS WHY ON THE EVENING OF STRANGERS, MY GRANDFATHER CAME TO MOURN WITH MY AUNTIES,
BUT YOU NEVER ONCE CAME TO HELP ME,
HAVE YOU FORGOTTEN YOUR SAKINA OH FATHER

arabic text:
HAR EKH TAMACHE PE SADAA UNKO MAI DETI
IKH BAAR BHI AYE NAHI LEKIN CHACHA GHAZI
JESE MUJHE PARDES MAI AMUU NE BHULAYA
KYA BHOOL GAYE APNI SAKINA KO EY BABA
english translation text:
EVERYTIME I WENT THROUGH TORTURE, I CALLED OUT TO HIM,
BUT NOT ONCE DID MY DEAR UNCLE ABBAS CAME TO SAVE ME,
AS IF MY UNCLE FORGOT ME IN THIS FOREIGN LAND,
HAVE YOU FORGOTTEN YOUR SAKINA OH FATHER

arabic text:
JESE HI JUDAA TU HUWA PARDES MAI MUJHSE
PABAAND RASAN HOGAYI AUR QAID BHI HAYE
AMMA KI TARHA SAR MERA MEHROOME RIDHA THA
KYA BHOOL GAYE APNI SAKINA KO EY BABA
english translation text:
AS SOON AS YOU AND I PARTED IN THE FOREIGN COUNTRY,
I WAS HAND CUFFED AND THROWN INTO PRISON,
JUST LIKE MY MUM, I TOO LOST MY HEAD COVERING,
HAVE YOU FORGOTTEN YOUR SAKINA OH FATHER

arabic text:
RUKTI HAI MERI SAANS KHABAR LIJIYE BABA
ESA NAHO BAN JAYE KAFAN YE KHOON BHARA KURTA
KYA BHOOL GAYE APNI SAKINA KO EY BABA
BETI KELIYE AB TOU KAFAN LAYIYE BABA
english translation text:
MY BREATH STOPS EVERY NOW AND THEN, HEAR THIS BABA,
BRING YOUR DAUGHTER A SHROUD PLEASE FATHER,
OTHERWISE I’M AFRAID THAT THIS CLOTHING WILL TURN INTO A SHROUD ITSELF
HAVE YOU FORGOTTEN YOUR SAKINA OH FATHER

arabic text:
ROTAY HUWE SAJJAD NE MOSHI YE KAHA JAAB
SHABIR KI TURBAT PE SAHAR TADHPAY HARAM SAB
THA WAQT E SHAHADAT BHI YE MASOOMA KA NOHA
KYA BHOOL GAYE APNI SAKINA KO EY BABA
english translation text:
SAJJAD SAID TO MOSHI WHILST CRYING,
SAHAR SHED TEARS, ON THE COFFIN OF HUSSAIN,
THIS WAS THE NOHA OF SAKINA AT THE TIME OF THE MARTYRDOM OF HUSSAIN,
HAVE YOU FORGOTTEN YOUR SAKINA OH FATHER
